verdict.rationale: First-party docs show one Fin agent deployed across live chat/messenger, email with complex threads, Slack communities and Connect channels, and WhatsApp and SMS, along with a broad 'every channel' claim. Social channels are not named, and in-app support is only implied by the messenger. missing for 10: explicit evidence of social channels (e.g. Facebook, Instagram, X), explicit in-app/mobile SDK deployment docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-channel coverage.
